notes.title: 1.2.0.1 Optimization
notes.content:
- Optimization
- Localization Update
- Rebalanced body punches. Body punches now deal less damage to health and drain more stamina from the opponent. (damage reduced from 100 to 60%)

notes.title: Update v 1.2
notes.content:
All career saves will be lost.

1. New Body movement 
2. Fouls and disqualification
3. New Skill - Dirty. Affects the probability of not detecting fouls. 9%(50 Skill) - 18%(100 Skill)
4. New map - Sparring
5. Unification in career mode
6. 3 new champions 
7. Referee in the ring
8. New appearance types and customize skin, hair and beard color
9. Sparring and punching bag in career mode
10. Speed up time after round
11. The default critical hit percentage has been reduced. (Can be changed in the Settings-Game)
12. Changed the ability to hit with low stamina
13. Settings: Field of View, spawn referee, fouls, body movement
14. Bags: some commands were not executed correctly in manager mode.

notes.title: 1.1.0.4 Game Settings
notes.content:

- Game settings (Damage, HP, KO chance, etc.)
- Autosave
- Auto Fight (Ai vs AI mode)
- Choosing a boxer's mentality in manager mode (for autofight)

New gameplay settings:
- Loss of skill points after defeat
- Count points by damage

Fixed bugs:
- Go into the ring
- Save Announcer Volume
